summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine PDMR share transaction. Heiko Schipper, Business Group President, Foods, sold 1,400 ordinary 3.5 pence shares at EUR 55.82 per share on Euronext Amsterdam, totaling EUR 78,148. The filing is a standard notification under UK/EU market abuse rules, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic implications. The event is purely administrative and does not trigger any special-situation category.
